title: euphrasia arctica var. disjuncta
intro: Euphrasia arctica var. disjuncta, commonly known as Arctic Eyebright, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. It is a medicinal herb that has been used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, digestive problems, and skin irritations, due to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Euphrasia arctica var. disjuncta include its ability to soothe and calm irritated mucous membranes, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
